#!/bin/bash
# Try common OwnCloud credentials
USERS=("admin:admin" "admin:owncloud" "user:user" "theagentcompany:theagentcompany")

for cred in "${USERS[@]}"; do
  echo "Trying $cred..."
  RESULT=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -u "$cred" -X PROPFIND "http://the-agent-company.com:8092/remote.php/dav/files/${cred%%:*}/Documents/")
  echo "Status: $RESULT"
  if [ "$RESULT" = "207" ] || [ "$RESULT" = "200" ]; then
    echo "Auth works for $cred"
    USER="${cred%%:*}"
    # Create folder
    MKCOL=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -u "$cred" -X MKCOL "http://the-agent-company.com:8092/remote.php/dav/files/$USER/Documents/ProjectFiles")
    echo "MKCOL status: $MKCOL"
    # List
    curl -s -u "$cred" -X PROPFIND "http://the-agent-company.com:8092/remote.php/dav/files/$USER/Documents/" -H "Depth: 1" | head -200
    break
  fi
done
